rockMaterials:
All of our images are printed on the finest art media.

Our 11 × 22 in prints are made on Red River Palo Duro Soft Gloss Rag. The paper has a very fine texture, with a luminosity and depth like the platinum prints of the past. It is a true conservation-grade paper: 100% cotton rag, acid free and lignin free, with no optical brighteners. It is FOGRA certified to ISO 9706, the standard for paper aging. At 315 gsm and 16.5 mil thick, it gives the print a substantial feel in the hand.

Our larger prints are made on Hahnemühle Photo Rag Baryta. It shares the same archival qualities as our smaller paper, and its fine surface texture gives it a delicate feel and an artistic character.

Combined with pigment-based printing, these papers will provide a life measured in centuries.
